item.title: How Far Can Appearance-Only Visual Memory Go? Evaluating SigLIP2 for Indoor Place Recognition
item.description: A systematic evaluation of SigLIP2 as a visual memory backbone for indoor place recognition, probing how far appearance-only embeddings can take us before geometry becomes non-negotiable.
